<!-- What does this change, and why? Link the issue if there is one. -->

- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`, `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] Bug fixes include a test that fails without the fix
- [ ] New or changed text is in both `messages/en.json` and `messages/fr.json`
- [ ] Visible changes were checked in the running app, with screenshots or a short recording below
